privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.content: To protect your privacy, we do not store your name, address, or phone number. Your phone number is converted into a temporary 050 virtual number and forwarded to the technician. The temporary number is retained for one week for your convenience and then permanently destroyed. Your service history is stored only on your device and will not be transferred if you switch devices.
